post.caption:
12 people walked past the old man. You were the 13th. 🍊

“So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.” (99:7)

Before Maghrib today: one small good. Pick something up, hold a door, carry someone's bag. Nobody needs to see it. Allah does. 🤍

verses.text: “So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.”

captions: 3:41 p.m. Late again. Eyes on your phone.
In the park, an old man drops his shopping.
Oranges roll across the path. People step around them.
At the gate you look back. He's still bent over. Alone.
You turn around. You kneel on the cold path.
Eleven oranges. One torn bag. Thirty seconds.
He smiles: “May Allah bless you, son.”
Nobody filmed it. Allah saw it.
